data.narrative:
Ursa Major Technologies is a Series E-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $85M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 3 private peers in the same sector and stage proximity (ICEYE at Series F valued at $12.0B; Apex Space at Series D valued at $2.3B; Varda Space Industries at Series D valued at $1.6B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base, applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E advancement, yielding $119M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, adjacent-stage companies produces a $2.3B median, with a range of $1.6B to $12.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue for the target. The peer set shows material dispersion, reflecting stage and business-model variation within frontier aerospace.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a median of $1.2B, with a low bound of $101M (stage-progression floor) and a high bound of $2.6B (upper quartile of peer range). This wide range reflects uncertainty around Ursa Major's relative position within its peer cohort and the nascent, capital-intensive nature of the sector. Revenue traction and technical milestones would be critical to narrowing this band.
